subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

A thermistor can have region of ________ determined by the construction material or the temperature of the material. The change in temperature can be due to internal effects such as current through the thermistor or due to external effects of _____.

options.text: positive or negative temperature coefficients; heating or cooling
positive or negative temperature coefficients; heating only

solution:
The correct answer is __positive or negative temperature coefficients; heating or cooling__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A thermistor is a type of resistor whose resistance is dependent on temperature, more so than in standard resistors.
 
• Thermistors generally have either a positive temperature coefficient (PTC) or a negative temperature coefficient (NTC).
